text:
Priya (CS): Heads-up — Pulsewell renewal coming in ~6 weeks (2026-05-10). We just saw a 57% drop in embeddings calls month-over-month and seat activity down from 22 -> 9. Need rapid triage.

Ethan (CSM): Oof. Any notes on why? New procurement? 

Priya (CS): Champion Greta was promoted out of the org last week. Also received a procurement note that they're running a 2-week spike with ScribeAI starting yesterday.

Nika (RevOps): I pulled the billing diff: embedding unit consumption -60%, generation tokens -40%. No billing disputes logged.

Sam (Eng): No error or latency regression on our side. Wondering if ScribeAI trial is using a different embedding model or lower dimensionality.

Ravi (Support): There was one ticket quoting cheaper per-embedding price and a request for "sample quantized perf comparison". I replied asking for use-case specifics.

Ethan (CSM): Action plan idea: offer a controlled bake-off (objective metrics), short Dedicated-lite trial for production parity, and a targeted price concession for the POC window. Agree?

Priya (CS): Agree. Also want to align legal on trial terms (no data export).

Nika (RevOps): I can draft a 10-day POC pricing addendum: 25% off embedding units, and a bill credit if they move to annual within 30 days. Need approval from pricing council.

Sam (Eng): I'll assemble a small reproducible benchmark: sanitized 800-doc corpus, two seeded prompts (semantic search + summarization), and scripts to compute precision@5 and avg cosine distance. Will push into /shared/pulsewell/bakeoff.

Ethan (CSM): Perfect. I'll invite Greta's replacement (Jae, Head of Data) and procurement (lynne@pulsewell) to the kickoff. Tentative Wed 10am PT.

Ravi (Support): Quick snippet I can run and share for perf numbers:
```
python infra/bench.py --dataset pulse_800.json --model rwd-embed-small --batch 128
```
I'll include tail latency and memory usage.

trial-bot: Trial instance provisioned: dedicated-lite-pulsewell-01 (expires in 10 days).

Priya (CS): Good. Two tactical asks before kickoff: (1) Nika, draft the concession language and trial waiver; (2) Sam & Ravi, get bench artifacts and a short README; (3) Ethan, confirm stakeholder invite list.

Nika (RevOps): On it. Will share a PDF by EOD.

Sam (Eng): Bench pushed at commit d4f7a. Link: https://redwood.internal/pulsewell/bakeoff. Added README with metric definitions (precision@k, mean cos distance, runtime per 1k queries).

Ethan (CSM): Invite sent for Wed 10am PT. Included success metrics: precision@5 >= 0.78 on semantic search, 90th pct latency <= 120ms.

Priya (CS): One more thing  if ScribeAI shows matching quality but lower list price, we should be prepared to surface our value: SLA, predictable throughput on Dedicated, and an onboarding/enablement credit. Nika, can you propose the enablement credit figure?

Nika (RevOps): Suggest a $10k enablement credit tied to a 12-month conversion. Will run that by finance.

Ravi (Support): I'll standby during the bake-off for realtime logs and any repro requests.

Ethan (CSM): Thanks team. We'll treat this like a micro-competition: objective metrics, tight timeline, and a recommended retention package if we win. Re-open thread after the bake-off with results. :sparkles:
